summary.intent: Automatically monitor PR #349 (cipher-box) for new bot review comments from CodeRabbit and Copilot, and resolve them as they arrive using a 5-minute cron loop.
summary.outcome: Three rounds of bot reviews were fully resolved (4 + 7 + 4 = 15 new threads across multiple commits), with real bugs fixed in recovery.html and useAuth.ts, plus doc clarifications in METADATA_SCHEMAS.md. The cron monitor ran successfully throughout.

repo: VaultBlobV2 type was removed; functions now return Uint8Array directly instead
IPNS records for vault key and root folder are separate derivations — conflating them (directRootIpnsName bug) caused recovery.html to use vault key IPNS for folder traversal
The TEE republishes IPNS records every 3 hours, so IPNS expiry concerns for the key blob are not applicable
sequence=0 on initial IPNS publishes is pre-existing intentional behavior across both vault.rs and useAuth.ts
CodeRabbit sometimes posts 'outside of diff range' comments that don't show up as reviewThreads in the GraphQL API
Copilot re-reviews on new pushes; CodeRabbit did not re-review after the final commit batch

code.finding: directRootIpnsName was being derived and then used as root folder IPNS name, but was actually the vault key IPNS name — fixed by deriving both separately

Broad try/catch over getVault() + fetchFromIpfs() meant a 404 from fetchFromIpfs (missing CID) would incorrectly trigger vault re-initialization for an existing user — fixed by giving getVault() its own try/catch
slice() was used where subarray() is preferred for zero-copy Uint8Array operations
Encryption table incorrectly stated 'ECIES (key) + AES-256-GCM (metadata)' for v2 blob — v2 is key-only (ECIES-wrapped rootFolderKey)
Referenced VaultBlobV2 type that no longer exists; should reference Uint8Array return type
IPNS table described v2 blob as 'ECIES key + metadata' — corrected to 'ECIES-wrapped rootFolderKey only'

workflow: The /loop skill with CronCreate enables fully automated PR review monitoring — cron fires the GraphQL check every 5 minutes and triggers /resolve-pr-reviews automatically
GraphQL reviewThreads API only returns inline thread comments; outside-diff-range comments appear only in the review body and require separate handling
Cron jobs auto-expire after 7 days; cancel early with CronDelete using the job ID
Replying to outside-diff-range comments requires posting a general PR comment rather than a thread reply since they have no resolvable thread ID

friction: GitHub API timed out on one cron tick (transient network issue), causing a false 'no new reviews' report
The GraphQL reviewThreads count showed 0 for 7 Copilot comments that were actually present — required a fallback fetch to discover them, suggesting the initial query missed newly created threads
Outside-diff-range comments from CodeRabbit's review (review #3996563546) were invisible to the monitoring query and had to be handled manually after the user pointed them out
Indentation inconsistency in useAuth.ts required a follow-up edit after the initial refactor
open_items: sequence=0 conflict handling in vault.rs and useAuth.ts: Copilot suggested aborting on conflict rather than warn-and-continue — deferred as pre-existing behavior but flagged as worth revisiting
IPNS record expiry for vault key blob: currently relies on TEE republishing every 3h — no client-side fallback if TEE is unavailable
CodeRabbit did not re-review after the final commit push — unclear if it requires manual trigger (@coderabbitai review) to catch the last round of changes
